audit: Fresh subprocess fully recomputes after the method submits; never supplied as corrective feedback.
baseline_gap: Free-LLM planner and wider operators are deferred until these classical controls establish a useful task.
claim_boundary: Development computational mechanism pilot; not physical product, confirmatory statistics or RSI efficacy.
failure_rule: Retain every claimed cell, blocked run, error and timeout; no silent replacement.
falsifier: Unsupported reuse, false acceptance, or planning overhead erases the savings.
hypothesis: Checked evidence transfer preserves computational predicates at lower total verification cost.
primary_metric: audit agreement, support coverage and measured total execution time
promotion: none; formal protocol requires later separate frozen confirmation
shared_knowledge: All arms receive the same public state, tool contracts and operator library.
statistic_unit: starting state/change/rule; events are not independent samples
timing: Measured method/planning/recompute time; independent audit cost reported separately; no invented price for skipped checks.
